Elden Ring Beginner Samurai Guide

In Elden Ring, a beginner Samurai can improve survivability by practicing the starting weapon.

Raise Vigor for survivability before spreading points across several offensive attributes. Keep stamina available for dodging after every attack and upgrade Uchigatana when Smithing Stones become available. Practice one attack at a time so you can recognize an enemy recovery window.

A beginner Samurai should raise Vigor for survivability and keep stamina available for dodging.

  • Preparation: review your available equipment before leaving.
  • Practice: preserve enough stamina to retreat after an attack.
